thingsToDo.title: Snow Canyon State Park
thingsToDo.description: Snow Canyon State Park is a state park in St George, Utah. Snow Canyon State Park near St. George preserves red and white Navajo sandstone, basalt flows, cinder cones, and desert habitat at the edge of the Mojave transition zone. The park was established in 1958 and renamed in 1962. Snow Canyon State Park is one of the best-known public landmarks linked to travel patterns around St George.

thingsToDo.title: Red Hills Desert Garden
thingsToDo.description: Red Hills Desert Garden is a desert botanical garden in St George, Utah. Red Hills Desert Garden is a public desert plant garden in St. George developed to showcase native Mojave Desert flora and interpreted landscapes around a restored red-rock watercourse. The site includes educational signage, trail loops, and habitat features tied to local conservation goals. Red Hills Desert Garden is one of the best-known public landmarks linked to travel patterns around St George.

thingsToDo.title: St. George Utah Temple
thingsToDo.description: St. George Utah Temple is a historic temple in St George, Utah. The St. George Utah Temple is a historic Latter-day Saint temple completed in 1877 and is the church’s oldest continuously operating temple. Its construction marked major settlement-era investment in southern Utah and established a prominent architectural landmark in St. St. George Utah Temple is one of the best-known public landmarks linked to travel patterns around St George.

thingsToDo.title: Pioneer Park
thingsToDo.description: Pioneer Park is a city park in St George, Utah. Pioneer Park is a municipal park in St. George with red-rock outcrops, short trails, and overlooks above downtown neighborhoods. The area preserves visible sandstone formations and historical pioneer-era features that connect to local settlement narratives. Pioneer Park is one of the best-known public landmarks linked to travel patterns around St George.

thingsToDo.title: Dinosaur Discovery Site at Johnson Farm
thingsToDo.description: Dinosaur Discovery Site at Johnson Farm is a paleontology museum in St George, Utah. The Dinosaur Discovery Site at Johnson Farm in St. George preserves extensive Early Jurassic dinosaur trackways exposed during construction in 2000. The museum opened to protect in-situ fossil surfaces and interpret regional paleontology through exhibits and research. Dinosaur Discovery Site at Johnson Farm is one of the best-known public landmarks linked to travel patterns around St George.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for St. George?
faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core St. George highlights plus one or two local experiences.

faq.q: Should I book tours ahead in St. George?
faq.a: Yes—advance booking is recommended for weekends, holidays, and top-rated operators.
